title: Default workflow adoption and duplicated-mechanics retirement
effect_of_pass: Authorize implementation of the exact closed default-workflow profile and non-destructive retirement inventory while preserving all governing-plan exceptions and permanent denials.
effect_of_defer: Preserve all current programme-specific mechanics and keep the proposal inactive.
effect_of_block: Mark DA-G6 blocked and preserve the completed Development Acceleration components as explicit opt-in services only.
effect_of_quarantine: Quarantine the adoption proposal without altering completed DA-WP1 through DA-WP5 records or active DA-G4B authority.
effect_of_supersede: Require a replacement adoption plan and new operator gate before any default activation or retirement.
